D0.name: ORIENTATION
D0.purpose: Identify the object, its current standing, its claim ceiling, and any material qualifier whose omission could change the user's conclusion.

D1.name: MEANING
D1.purpose: Explain what the object or test means within its declared scope without reclassification.

D2.name: STRUCTURE
D2.purpose: Expose registered structural relations, model/test structure, or other already-declared internal organization without inventing relations.

D3.name: EVIDENCE
D3.purpose: Expose evidence details, adverse findings, limitations, scores, uncertainty, and comparator context without changing standing.

D4.name: PROVENANCE
D4.purpose: Expose source identity, authority, versions, hashes, workflow or artifact identity, and custody/provenance facts already bound upstream.
